## Edit the generator or the design, not this file. Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.

COLDWAR_ISR_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ISR NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_initialized
		# start spirits
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_nation_in_arms } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_nation_in_arms }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_3 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_ingathering } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_ingathering }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_war_of_attrition } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_war_of_attrition }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_histadrut_state_3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_histadrut_state_3 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_dimona_programme } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_dimona_programme }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_mizrachi_gap_3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_mizrachi_gap_3 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_status_quo_2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_status_quo_2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_water_question_2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_water_question_2 }
		# meters, territories, Aliyah, ban counter
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora = 70 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settlers = 15 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden = 30 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing = 50 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden_mod = 10 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_208 = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_admin_208 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_outposts_208 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_fence_208 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_587 = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_admin_587 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_outposts_587 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_fence_587 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_213 = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_admin_213 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_outposts_213 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_fence_213 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_209 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_admin_209 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_outposts_209 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_fence_209 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_207 = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_admin_207 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_outposts_207 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_fence_207 = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_bonus = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_ban = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_annex_laws = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_income = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_expense = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dark_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_mod = 0 }
		# dynamic modifiers
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_economy_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_economy_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_territories_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_territories_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_society_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_society_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_army_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_army_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_security_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_security_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_foreign_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_foreign_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora_lifeline } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora_lifeline } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_military_government } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_military_government } }
		COLDWAR_ISR_recalculate = yes
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_ISR_month_next_day = global.num_days }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_change_diaspora = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora = COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora min = 0 max = 100 }
}

COLDWAR_ISR_change_settlers = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settlers = COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_settlers min = 0 max = 100 }
}

COLDWAR_ISR_change_burden = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden_mod = COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta }
	COLDWAR_ISR_recalculate_burden = yes
}

COLDWAR_ISR_change_standing = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing = COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_standing min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora_expectations check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta < 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora = COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	COLDWAR_ISR_standing_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_ISR_recalculate_burden = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 0 }
	if = { limit = { 208 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 209 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 587 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 213 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 207 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden = COLDWAR_ISR_held }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden = 5 }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_mod }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_burden min = 0 max = 100 }
}

COLDWAR_ISR_standing_refresh = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing < 35 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_pariah } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_pariah } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_pariah } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_pariah }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing > 65 } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_respected } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_respected } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_respected } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_respected }
}

	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_ISR_ladder_defence_milder_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_3 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_2 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_1
			}
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_recalculate = {
	COLDWAR_ISR_recalculate_burden = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_standing_refresh = yes
	# The Diaspora Lifeline
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dl_research = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dl_research = 0.0005 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora > 59 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dl_interest = -0.5 } }
	else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dl_interest = 0 } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_income = gdp_total }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_income = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_income = 0.00012 }
	divide_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_income = 52 }
	# Occupation Burden: money gdp_total x burden x 0.00004 per month, booked weekly (x 12 / 52)
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_expense = gdp_total }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_expense = COLDWAR_ISR_burden }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_expense = 0.00048 }
	divide_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_weekly_expense = 52 }
	# The Military Government
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 0 }
	if = { limit = { 208 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 209 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 587 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 213 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { 207 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_held = 1 } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_police = COLDWAR_ISR_held }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_police = 0.02 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_b = COLDWAR_ISR_burden }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_b = 0.001 }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_police = COLDWAR_ISR_b }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_stab = COLDWAR_ISR_held }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_stab = -0.005 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_b = COLDWAR_ISR_burden }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_b = -0.0005 }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_stab = COLDWAR_ISR_b }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settlers > 59 } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mg_stab = -0.02 } }
	# resistance in the held territories
	208 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = COLDWAR_ISR_res }
			if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_two_legal_systems } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = 0.05 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
	}
	209 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = COLDWAR_ISR_res }
			if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_two_legal_systems } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = 0.05 } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
	}
	587 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = COLDWAR_ISR_res }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
	}
	213 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = COLDWAR_ISR_res }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
	}
	207 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT } } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_res_total = COLDWAR_ISR_res }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
		}
		else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_occupation } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_208 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_209 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_587 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_213 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_207 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_chance_208 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_chance_209 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_chance_587 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_chance_213 = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_chance_207 = yes
}

COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_chance_208 = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { 208 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = 208.resistance }
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = 3 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_208 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pv = COLDWAR_ISR_burden }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pv = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = COLDWAR_ISR_pv }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pv = COLDWAR_ISR_dark_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pv = 0.5 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = COLDWAR_ISR_pv }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_admin_208 = 2 } } multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = 0.5 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 = COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_mod }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 min = 0 max = 12 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_208 = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 = 208.resistance }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 = 0.2 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_rv = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_208 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_rv = 4 }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 = COLDWAR_ISR_rv }
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 = 10 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_rv = COLDWAR_ISR_fence_208 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_rv = 5 }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 = COLDWAR_ISR_rv }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 min = 0 max = 50 }
}

COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_roll_208 = {
	COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_chance_208 = yes
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_revenge_208 } }
		random_list = {
			60 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.300 days = 10 random_days = 30 } }
			30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.301 days = 10 random_days = 30 } }
			10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.302 days = 10 random_days = 30 } }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_two_legal_systems_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_two_legal_systems OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_citizenship_208 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_autonomy_208 NOT = { 208 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } } } OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_citizenship_209 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_autonomy_209 NOT = { 209 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } } } }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_two_legal_systems
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_wave_effect = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_wave_preview = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_bonus }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_wave_preview = 1 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_wave_preview = 0.10 }
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_wave_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_wave_pop = COLDWAR_ISR_wave_preview }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_wave_work = 0.01 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_vienna_dropouts NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_no_dropouts } } multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_wave_pop = 0.6 } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_wave_modifier } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_wave_modifier } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_wave_modifier days = 365 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_aliyah_bonus = 0 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_ban_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_ban > 2 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_banned } NOT = { nationalist_fascist_are_in_power = yes } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_banned
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.80 days = 1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_map_pay_outpost_208 = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult = COLDWAR_ISR_mapcost_outpost_208 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult min = -0.75 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pp_refund = COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pp_refund = -25 }
	add_political_power = COLDWAR_ISR_pp_refund
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_money_mult = COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_money_mult = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.001 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_ISR_money_mult }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
}

COLDWAR_ISR_map_pay_settlement_208 = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult = COLDWAR_ISR_mapcost_settlement_208 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settlers > 59 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult = -0.1 } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult min = -0.75 max = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pp_refund = COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_pp_refund = -25 }
	add_political_power = COLDWAR_ISR_pp_refund
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_money_mult = COLDWAR_ISR_cost_mult }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_money_mult = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.002 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_ISR_money_mult }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
}

COLDWAR_ISR_monthly = {
	COLDWAR_ISR_recalculate = yes
	# Diaspora drifts towards International Standing (0.2 a month)
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora > COLDWAR_ISR_standing } } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora = 0.2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora < COLDWAR_ISR_standing } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora = 0.2 } }
	# Two Legal Systems
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_two_legal_systems }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora = 0.2 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_standing min = 0 max = 100 }
	# Settler Movement 60 or more: Mafdal and the Radical National Front grow
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settlers > 59 } }
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.001 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 21 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.001 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
	}
	# The Mizrachi Gap at its harshest: the Mizrachi vote goes to Gahal and Likud
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_mizrachi_gap_3 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_index = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.001 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.001 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
	}
	# The Burden of Defence: the last step ends with peace with Egypt
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_1 has_war = no COLDWAR_ISR_peace_with_egypt = yes }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_burden_of_defence_1
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
	}
	# Lebanese Quagmire after a year of war in Lebanon
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_lebanese_quagmire_watch country_exists = LEB has_war_with = LEB }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_lebanon_war_months = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_lebanon_war_months > 11 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_lik_lebanese_quagmire } western_conservatism_are_in_power = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_ISR_lik_lebanese_quagmire }
	}
	# Pre-emptive strike doctrine: planning bonus at the start of a war
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_preemptive_doctrine has_war = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_at_war_last_month } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_ISR_emc_preemptive_strike days = 30 }
	}
	# Centurion Partners: London stops the spare parts at the start of every Israeli war
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_centurion_embargo_risk has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_deal_centurion_partners_ENG has_war = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_at_war_last_month } }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_ISR_for_centurion_embargo days = 180 }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_at_war_last_month }
	else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_at_war_last_month }
	# London sight allocation: halved while British opinion is below 0 (paid each January), restored when it recovers
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight_lost } country_exists = ENG ENG = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value < 0 } } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight_lost
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.85 days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight_lost OR = { NOT = { country_exists = ENG } ENG = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > -1 } } } }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight_lost
	}
	# Satellite launch: MD's space special project completed (sp_space_program)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_satellite_launched } is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_space_program }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_satellite_launched
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_space_programme } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_sec_recon_factor = 0.05 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_sec_research_speed_factor = 0.02 } force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
	}
	# Background pulse: incidents in the held regions and fedayeen raids from Lebanon and across the Jordan
	if = {
		limit = { 208 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_208 } }
			random_list = {
				60 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.330 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.300 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.301 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 209 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_209 } }
			random_list = {
				60 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.331 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.303 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.304 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 587 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_587 } }
			random_list = {
				60 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.332 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.306 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.307 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 213 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_213 } }
			random_list = {
				60 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.333 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.309 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.310 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 207 = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_pulse_207 } }
			random_list = {
				60 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.334 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				30 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.312 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
				10 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.313 days = 1 random_days = 20 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { country_exists = LEB is_neighbor_of = LEB } random_list = { 3 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.335 days = 1 random_days = 20 } } 97 = { } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = JOR is_neighbor_of = JOR } random_list = { 3 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.336 days = 1 random_days = 20 } } 97 = { } } }
	# Media backlash: the counter of dark actions decays (x0.9 a month); chance 3 % per point, +5 % below 35 and +5 % below 20 International Standing, at most 30 %
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dark_count = 0.9 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_media_cooldown } }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mc = COLDWAR_ISR_dark_count }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mc = 3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing < 35 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mc = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_standing < 20 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_mc = 5 } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_mc min = 0 max = 30 }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = COLDWAR_ISR_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_roll < COLDWAR_ISR_mc } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_ISR_media_cooldown days = 120 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_media_sev = 1 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dark_count > 2.99 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_media_sev = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_dark_count > 5.99 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_media_sev = 3 } }
			random_list = {
				1 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.320 days = 3 } }
				1 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.321 days = 3 } }
				1 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.322 days = 3 } }
				1 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.323 days = 3 } }
				1 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.324 days = 3 } }
				1 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.325 days = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	# Uprising: the territories flag for later foci
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_burden > 60 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_uprising } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_uprising }
	# Intifada doctrine (ter_q3): the suppression bonus comes with the first uprising
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_intifada_doctrine has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_uprising NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_intifada_doctrine_done } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_intifada_doctrine_done
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_ter_root_out_resistance_effectiveness_factor = 0.15 }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	# Radical National Front ban pending while it governs
	COLDWAR_ISR_ban_check = yes
	COLDWAR_ISR_deal_reconcile = yes
	# yearly (each January)
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1971.1.1 date < 1971.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1971 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1971
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1972.1.1 date < 1972.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1972 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1972
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1973.1.1 date < 1973.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1973 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1973
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1974.1.1 date < 1974.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1974 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1974
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1975.1.1 date < 1975.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1975 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1975
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1976.1.1 date < 1976.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1976 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1976
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1977.1.1 date < 1977.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1977 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1977
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1978.1.1 date < 1978.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1978 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1978
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1979.1.1 date < 1979.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1979 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1979
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1980.1.1 date < 1980.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1980 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1980
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1981.1.1 date < 1981.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1981 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1981
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1982.1.1 date < 1982.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1982 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1982
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1983.1.1 date < 1983.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1983 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1983
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1984.1.1 date < 1984.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1984 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1984
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1985.1.1 date < 1985.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1985 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1985
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1986.1.1 date < 1986.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1986 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1986
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1987.1.1 date < 1987.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1987 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1987
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1988.1.1 date < 1988.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1988 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1988
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1989.1.1 date < 1989.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1989 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1989
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1990.1.1 date < 1990.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1990 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1990
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1991.1.1 date < 1991.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1991 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1991
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1992.1.1 date < 1992.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1992 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1992
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1993.1.1 date < 1993.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1993 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1993
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1994.1.1 date < 1994.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1994 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1994
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1995.1.1 date < 1995.2.1 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1995 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_year_1995
		COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_ISR_yearly = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_settlers_yearly nationalist_fascist_are_in_power = yes } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta = 5 } COLDWAR_ISR_change_settlers = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_settlers_yearly_cap has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_rnf_eretz_yisrael_hashlema } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta = 5 } COLDWAR_ISR_change_settlers = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_rak_histadrut_yearly emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes } set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 5 } change_labour_unions_opinion = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_desalination_running } set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.002 } } modify_treasury_effect = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_index_linked has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_econ_index_linked } add_to_variable = { inflation_rate_var = 0.05 } calculate_inflation_effects = yes }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_london_sight_lost } set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.005 } } modify_treasury_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_us_settlement_linkage }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_208 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_209 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_587 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_213 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum = COLDWAR_ISR_settle_207 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_settle_sum > 4 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_ISR_for_us_displeasure days = 365 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_gush_emunim_risk }
		random_list = { 25 = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.66 days = 15 } } 75 = { } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_deal_pariah_pact }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF SAF = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_psigned_pariah_pact } } SAF = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.400 days = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_deal_emergency_credit }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_psigned_emergency_credit } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.401 days = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_deal_bucharest_route }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.005 } }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ROM ROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_psigned_bucharest_route } } ROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.402 days = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_ISR_deal_special_relationship }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_psigned_special_relationship } } USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.403 days = 1 } } }
	}
}
